root_cause.text: The `sof_ipc4_control_load_bytes` function in `sound/soc/sof/ipc4-topology.c` allocated memory for `scontrol->ipc_control_data` using only `scontrol->max_size`, which failed to account for the size of the kernel-only `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `kzalloc(scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` with `kzalloc(sizeof(*control_data) + scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` to ensure that the allocated memory includes both the kernel-only `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` and the maximum payload size.

This fails to account for the size of the kernel-only `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` structure, which is prepended to the control data. The actual required size is `scontrol->max_size + sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data)` (or `scontrol->max_size` is incorrectly assumed to include this kernel-only structure size in the checks on lines 1509-1519).
